tasks.instruction: Wstaw wyraz podany wielkimi literami w odpowiedniej formie gramatycznej, np. BIG - bigger, WATCH - watched. Wyrazu nie mozna wstawic w formie niezmienionej.

items.sentence: I try to speak English fluently and build sentences that are __________ correct.
The words in the dictionary are in the __________ order.
In __________ with Tokyo, life in Warsaw and Prague is cheap.
The headmaster's speech was so long that I almost died of __________.
Paula and Jack have three children. Paula also has a daughter from a previous __________.
It is __________ in Poland to sell alcohol to people under 18.
She didn't realize that __________ films from the Internet is illegal.
Mark is very __________. He wants to be the best at everything.
The last Batman movie was so __________ - you knew exactly how it was going to end.
You can __________ your tea with honey instead of sugar.
